text:
sofia: quick Q — during the PM demo they asked whether saved console views should remember the model variant + a quota hint (eg prefer quantized/cheap variant). currently saved queries only store filters and columns.

mira: I pushed a quick mock in Figma showing a small "model pin" dropdown inside saved view modal. PM likes it but worried about scope: is this purely UI or does it need a routing/policy API contract?

jack: if we persist a model_variant in the saved view, we need runtime enforcement. otherwise users will save views that reference variants we no longer host and the console will be misleading. :grimacing:

alex: could be two parts: (1) saved view metadata includes optional model_hint and quota_hint, (2) console resolves model_hint via the routing API at render time and shows a resolution badge (eg "served by: open-rl-7b-quant (fallback: open-rl-7b)").

mira: agreed — UI should show resolved variant + cost delta. proposal: saved view stores:
```
{"scope":"route:credit-check","filters":["status:200"],"model_hint":"open-rl-7b-quant","quota_hint":"low_cost"}
```

sofia: that payload looks good. question for eng-platform: do we extend /routes/:id/views to accept model_hint & quota_hint or create a separate binding to the routing policy API?

jack: I'd avoid coupling saved-views to routing policy storage. Better: views are pure UI metadata, and console calls a resolver service to get current effective variant + an explanation. That keeps view storage simple and lets routing rules live in one place.

alex: also need telemetry changes: ingestion needs to label tokens with model_variant (and quantization level) so the console can show per-variant latency/cost breakdowns for that saved view. otherwise cost previews will be wrong.

mira: good catch. that means observability schema change (ingestion event add "model_variant":string). Who owns that? eng-telemetry or eng-runtime?

jack: runtime should populate variant, telemetry team owns ingestion schema and downstream traces. I'll loop in @product-bot to create a ticket.

product-bot: created TICKET-2142 "saved-view model_hint UX + resolver API" assigned to eng-platform, telemetry cc: eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:

sofia: UX ask: add an optional "enforce variant on open" toggle. If on, console will request a transient routing override at render time (best-effort) to bias toward the variant; if fail, show a warning and the resolved variant. This helps reproducibility for screenshots/evals.

jack: we need policies around who can toggle enforce (org/admin). also ensure limits so a saved view can't force expensive variants for many users (quota abuse).

mira: can we surface expected cost impact in the saved view modal? small inline calc using sample rate + per-token estimates would help PMs decide.

alex: easy to show a delta badge. exact numbers depend on telemetry + per-variant unit prices. we'll stub with heuristics in first pass.

sofia: action items:
- jack: design resolver API + failure modes
- mira: update mock to include resolution badge + cost delta
- alex: add telemetry schema note (model_variant) and sample-rate implications
- product-bot: file follow-ups

mira: fine to ship as "view metadata + resolver" first, enforcement and routing override in a follow-up. :+1:

sofia: perfect. thanks all — tagging this for next sprint planning.
